title: Refuse or shorten a context socket path longer than the AF_UNIX limit instead of crash-looping serve-context
notes: Found 2026-11-23: with a data directory whose absolute path is long, <data>/atrium/context.sock exceeds the macOS 104-byte sun_path limit and 'atrium serve-context' dies with 'OSError: AF_UNIX path too long'; under launchd it respawns every 30 s forever. A 30-character data path works.
done_when: serve-context either binds through a short path or exits with one clear message, and atrium doctor reports the cause
